help.support.title: Support
help.support.summary: How to reach us, answers to common questions, and the Mahaam apps.
help.support.about.heading: What Mahaam is
help.support.about.body:
Mahaam is project management and time tracking for teams and the clients they work for. A team keeps its projects, tasks, issues and time in one workspace, turns tracked time into reports and invoices, and can invite its clients to a customer portal where they see only what the team shares with them.

Mahaam works on the web, on iPhone, iPad and Android, on your desktop and in your browser, with one account for all of them.
help.support.contact.heading: Get help
help.support.signin.heading: Signing in and forgotten passwords
help.support.signin.body:
Sign in with the email address and password you registered with. Where the sign-in page shows **Continue with Google** or **Continue with GitHub**, you can use that account instead.

**Forgot your password?** On the sign-in page choose **Forgot password?** and enter your email address. We email you a 6-digit code that works for 10 minutes; enter it and choose a new password.

If the email doesn't arrive, check your spam folder and make sure you typed the address you signed up with. If you no longer have access to that email address, write to us at [{email}](mailto:{email}).
help.support.twofactor.heading: Two-factor sign-in and a lost phone
help.support.twofactor.body:
Two-factor authentication adds a code from an authenticator app to your password, so a stolen password alone can't open your account. Turn it on in **My profile** on the web, or in **Settings → Two-step verification** in the mobile app. While you set it up you get **recovery codes**: save them somewhere safe, away from your phone.

**Lost or replaced your phone?** On the sign-in page, after your password, choose **Use a recovery code instead** and enter one of your saved codes. Each code works once. When you're back in, set up two-factor authentication again on your new phone and make new recovery codes.

**Code not accepted?** Check that your phone's clock is set automatically; the codes depend on it.

**No recovery codes either?** Write to us at [{email}](mailto:{email}) from the email address on your account. For your safety we must confirm that the account is really yours before we can help, so this takes longer than using a recovery code.
help.support.join.heading: Joining a workspace
help.support.join.body:
Work in Mahaam happens in workspaces, and you can only join one when it invites you. **Ask an owner or an admin of the workspace to invite your email address.** You'll get an email with an invitation link: open it, then sign in or create an account **with the same email address the invitation was sent to**.

If the link says it has expired or has already been used, ask for a new invitation. Clients are invited the same way, and they see only the workspace's customer portal.

Starting something new? You can create your own workspace from the Workspaces page and invite your team.
help.support.language.heading: Changing the language
help.support.language.body:
Mahaam is available in English and Arabic, and the Arabic version reads right to left.

- **On the web:** use the language button at the top of any page, or set your language in **My profile**.
- **In the mobile app:** go to **Settings → Language & appearance**. The app may ask you to restart it to finish switching the layout direction.
help.support.notifications.heading: Notifications
help.support.notifications.body:
Mahaam tells you when something needs you, such as a task assigned to you or a comment on your work. Everything appears in the bell at the top of the app.

- **On the web:** in each workspace, **Settings → Notifications** lets you mute kinds of notification and, where the server sends email, choose email and a daily digest. If you install the web app, your browser can show push notifications too.
- **On your phone:** allow notifications when the app asks. To stop them, turn them off for Mahaam in your phone's settings.
- Signing out of a device stops its notifications.

**Not getting a notification you expected?** Check that that kind isn't muted in your notification settings, that notifications are allowed for Mahaam in your phone or browser settings, and that Focus or Do Not Disturb is off.
help.support.delete.heading: Deleting your account
help.support.delete.body: You can delete your account yourself, in the mobile app or on the web, and you then have 14 days to change your mind. [Delete your Mahaam account](/{locale}/delete-account) has the steps, what is removed and what is kept, and what to do if you can't sign in.
help.support.apps.heading: Mahaam apps
help.support.apps.body:
One Mahaam account works in all of these:

- **Web:** here, in any up-to-date browser. It's always the latest version, with nothing to install. Your browser can also install it as an app.
- **iPhone and iPad:** **Mahaam** on the App Store.
- **Android:** **Mahaam** on Google Play.
- **Desktop** for macOS, Windows and Linux, with a timer in the menu bar or system tray. It updates itself.
- **Chrome extension:** your timer, your next tasks and issues, and a quick way to file an issue or log time for the page you're on.

**Which version do I have?** In the mobile app it's at the bottom of **Settings**; in the desktop app it's in **Settings → About**; for the extension, look on your browser's extensions page. Please include it when you write to us. If something isn't working, update to the latest version first.
help.support.legal.heading: Terms and privacy
help.support.legal.body: Using Mahaam means agreeing to the [Terms of Service](/{locale}/legal/terms). The [Privacy Policy](/{locale}/legal/privacy) explains what we collect and why, who else handles it, and how to get a copy of your data or have it deleted.
help.delete.title: Delete your Mahaam account
help.delete.summary: How to delete your account in the Mahaam app or on the web, what happens to your data, and what to do if you can't sign in.
help.delete.app.heading: The app and its developer
help.delete.app.body: This page is about deleting your account in **Mahaam**, the project management and time tracking app, developed by **{developer}**. You have one Mahaam account for the mobile app (iPhone, iPad and Android), the web, the desktop app and the browser extension, so deleting it in one place deletes it everywhere.
help.delete.inapp.heading: In the mobile app
help.delete.inapp.body:
1. Open Mahaam and sign in.
2. Tap the gear icon at the top to open **Settings**.
3. Under **Danger zone**, tap **Delete account**.
4. Enter your password, and a code from your authenticator app if you use two-factor authentication.
5. Tick the box to confirm that you understand, then tap **Delete my account**.

You're signed out straight away.
help.delete.web.heading: On the web
help.delete.web.body:
1. [Sign in to Mahaam](/{locale}/workspaces) and open any of your workspaces.
2. Open your account menu at the top of the page and choose **My profile**.
3. At the bottom, under **Delete account**, choose **Delete my account**.
4. Enter your password, and a code from your authenticator app if you use two-factor authentication.
5. Choose **Delete account** to confirm.

If you aren't in any workspace, use the mobile app, or email us as described below.
help.delete.owners.heading: If you own a workspace
help.delete.owners.body:
If you're the **only owner** of a workspace, you first need to make another member an owner or delete that workspace; the app lists the workspaces concerned when you try. This keeps one account from taking a whole team's work down with it.

Deleting a workspace deletes its content, such as its projects, tasks, time and invoices, for everyone in it.
help.delete.after.heading: What happens next
help.delete.after.body:
- **Straight away:** you're signed out everywhere at once, and every access token, device and connected agent stops working.
- **For 14 days:** you can change your mind. **Signing in again during those 14 days cancels the deletion.**
- **After 14 days:** the account is permanently anonymised. Your email address, name, picture and password are removed, and so are your workspace memberships, your inbox, your devices (including their notification tokens) and your connections. This can't be undone.
help.delete.kept.heading: What is kept, and why
help.delete.kept.body:
Work you did in a **shared workspace**, such as comments, or time entries on an invoice, stays with that workspace, attributed to a deleted user. It's part of other people's records, such as a team's project history or a client's invoice. To ask for something you wrote there to be removed, contact the workspace's owners.

Our servers' technical logs and crash reports are kept for a limited time and then deleted. If a workspace paid for a plan, its billing records are held by Polar, our merchant of record, under Polar's own terms. The [Privacy Policy](/{locale}/legal/privacy#deletion) has the details.
help.delete.nosignin.heading: If you can't sign in
help.delete.nosignin.body:
If you can't sign in, for example because you no longer have access to your email address, or you lost your phone and your two-factor recovery codes, email [{email}](mailto:{email}) with the subject **Delete my account**. Write from the email address on the account if you still can. We'll confirm that the account is yours before we delete it, and we'll answer within 30 days. The same 14-day grace period and the same rules apply.

If you'd like a copy of your data before it goes, ask at the same address.
